shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat package.json; echo '--- tsconfig ---'; cat tsconfig.json; echo '--- vite ---'; cat vite.config.ts; echo '--- index ---'; cat index.html"
/bin/bash -c "cat src/App.tsx; echo '--- main ---'; cat src/main.tsx; echo '--- vite-env ---'; cat src/vite-env.d.ts; echo '--- CLAUDE.md ---'; cat CLAUDE.md"
/bin/bash -c "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo '---'; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | rg -i 'toast|button' | head -40"

/bin/bash -c "echo '=== Toaster/index.d.ts ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/index.d.ts; echo '=== Toaster.d.ts ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts; echo '=== useToaster.d.ts ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.d.ts; echo '=== types.d.ts ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -c "echo '=== Button docs refs ==='; rg -n -i -C 3 'Button' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -80; echo '=== Button d.ts ==='; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | rg -i 'Button' | head -20"

/bin/bash -c "echo '=== Toaster constants.d.ts ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/constants.d.ts; echo '=== Toast.d.ts ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.d.ts; echo '=== ToasterProvider.d.ts ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts; echo '=== ToasterComponent.d.ts ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts"

/bin/bash -c "echo '=== Button/index.d.ts ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/index.d.ts; echo '=== Button.d.ts ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; echo '=== Button constants ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/constants.d.ts"

/bin/bash -c "echo '=== root index exports (Toaster/Button) ==='; rg -n 'Toaster|Button|Icon' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -40; echo '=== package exports ==='; node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({main:p.main,module:p.module,types:p.types,exports:p.exports},null,2))\" | head -60"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n 'Toaster|Toast|Button|Icon' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -40; echo '=== hooks index ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/index.d.ts | head -20"

/bin/bash -c "echo '=== useToaster.js ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.js; echo '=== useInToasterContext.js ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/hooks/useInToasterContext.js; echo '=== ToasterComponent.js ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.js"

/bin/bash -c "echo '=== ToasterProvider.js ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.js; echo '=== ToasterContext.d.ts/js ==='; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterContext.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterContext.js"
